_about: 1-Propanol (1) + n-Pentane (2): isothermal total pressures at 468.15 K. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of 1-propanol, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record. Rows with x_1 = 0 and 1 are the pure-component pressures measured with the same set.

source.citation: S. Jung, M. S. Shin, H. Kim, Vapor-Liquid Equilibria for the n-Pentane + 1-Propanol and n-Pentane + 2-Methyl-1-propanol Systems near the Critical Region, J. Chem. Eng. Data 51 (2006) 656-659
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
